title: 这一次，交给你
title_en: This Time, I Entrust It to You

patient.name: 久宇舞弥
patient.setting: 成年女性；沉着克制、习惯事先替所有人安排交接的患者。星见医院首次专属传奇病例。
patient.setting_en: An adult woman—composed, methodical, and accustomed to preparing handovers for everyone else first. An authored legendary first case at Hoshimi Hospital.
patient.diagnosis: 胰头实性假乳头状肿瘤（倾向）伴 PV/SMV 静脉受累
patient.diagnosis_en: Suspected solid pseudopapillary neoplasm of the pancreatic head with PV/SMV involvement

day1.title: 这一次，交给你
day1.title_en: This Time, I Entrust It to You

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「门诊咨询室的门被轻轻叩响。坂口刚说了声『请进』，来人便已经把预约单平整地放在桌角。」
lines.text_en: “A soft knock came at the consultation-room door. By the time Sakaguchi said, ‘Come in,’ the visitor had already laid her appointment slip neatly at the corner of the desk.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「久宇舞弥。九点的复诊预约。我提前到了六分钟。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya Hisau. Nine o’clock follow-up appointment. I’m six minutes early.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「时间正好。请坐。」
lines.text_en: “Right on time. Please, have a seat.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥坐下，膝上放着一个薄薄的资料夹。透明封套里，从影像报告到用药记录，全部按照日期排列。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya sat with a slim folder on her lap. Inside its clear sleeves, everything from imaging reports to medication records was arranged by date.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「资料整理得很完整。今天我主要想听听你自己的情况。最近有没有新的不适？」
lines.text_en: “This is a thorough set of records. Today I’d also like to hear how you’ve been. Any new symptoms?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「饭后偶尔会不舒服。没有剧烈疼痛。食量比以前小一点，不过还可以正常工作。」
lines.text_en: “Some discomfort after meals. No severe pain. My appetite is a little smaller, but I can still work normally.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「体重呢？」
lines.text_en: “And your weight?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「近一段时间有下降，数字写在第三页。每天早上同一时间测量。」
lines.text_en: “It has gone down recently. The figures are on page three, taken at the same time each morning.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口翻到第三页。那张表格不仅记了体重，还写着进食时间、腹部不适的持续分钟数，以及她当时是否正在工作。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi turned to page three. The table recorded not just her weight, but meal times, how many minutes each episode of abdominal discomfort lasted, and whether she had been working.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你把自己观察得很仔细。」
lines.text_en: “You’ve been observing yourself very carefully.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「有记录的话，别人接手会快一点。」
lines.text_en: “Records make it easier for someone else to take over.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「接手什么？」
lines.text_en: “Take over what?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「需要有人处理的事情。工作、家里的安排，或者病历。」
lines.text_en: “Anything that needs handling. Work, things at home, or the medical record.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她说得理所当然，仿佛这三样只是在同一份清单上相邻的栏目。」
lines.text_en: “She said it as though all three belonged to adjacent columns on the same checklist.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「医院的部分由我们接手。你带来的记录很有帮助，但你不必把自己的手术也组织成一项工作任务。」
lines.text_en: “We’ll take over the hospital part. Your records help, but you don’t need to organize your own operation like another work assignment.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我明白。我只是想尽量减少不必要的等待。」
lines.text_en: “Understood. I just want to minimize unnecessary waiting.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我相信你能做到。不过在医院，有时等候本身就是治疗的一部分。」
lines.text_en: “I’m sure you can. But in a hospital, waiting is sometimes part of the treatment.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这点比我想的难控制。」
lines.text_en: “That is harder to control than I expected.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口合上那份工作日历，把影像报告抽到最上面。舞弥的目光跟着移动，仍然安静得几乎没有表情。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi closed the work calendar and moved the imaging report to the top. Maiya followed the motion with her eyes, her expression almost entirely composed.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这次复查的影像，和先前的检查结果合在一起看，需要认真讨论手术。阿尔托莉雅医生稍后也会参加。」
lines.text_en: “Taken together with the earlier studies, your new images warrant a serious surgical discussion. Dr. Artoria will join us shortly.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「两名外科医生一起说明？」
lines.text_en: “Two surgeons for the explanation?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这台手术涉及的结构比较复杂。我们希望你能听到完整方案，再决定下一步。」
lines.text_en: “The structures involved make this a complex operation. We want you to hear the full plan before you decide what comes next.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那么，我把后面的时间全部空出来。」
lines.text_en: “Then I’ll clear the rest of my schedule.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「今天只需要先听完、问清楚。不用在十分钟内做完所有决定。」
lines.text_en: “Today, you only need to listen and ask your questions. You don’t have to make every decision in ten minutes.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……这个安排，我试着接受。」
lines.text_en: “…I’ll try to accept that arrangement.”

choices.label: 「先把最关心的问题问出来就好。」
choices.label_en: “Start with the question that matters most to you.”

choices.label: 「我会陪你把时间表重新排好。」

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「先把最关心的问题问出来就好。别按报告页码的顺序来。」
lines.text_en: “Start with the question that matters most. You don’t have to follow the page numbers.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我可以先问手术会持续多久吗？」
lines.text_en: “Then may I ask how long the operation will take?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「当然。这正是我们待会儿要仔细解释的部分。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. That’s exactly what we’re going to explain.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我会陪你把时间表重新排好。术前、手术和恢复期，各有需要留出的时间。」
lines.text_en: “I’ll help you rearrange it. Preparation, surgery, and recovery each need time of their own.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「谢谢。那我先不用把出院日期写死。」
lines.text_en: “Thank you. Then I won’t fix a discharge date just yet.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「对。让恢复情况决定日期。」
lines.text_en: “Exactly. Let your recovery determine the date.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥取下工作日历最上面那张便利贴，折了两下，放回资料夹。她的动作没有丝毫慌乱，却终于不再继续核对下一条日程。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya removed the top sticky note from her calendar, folded it twice, and returned it to the folder. Her hands were steady. For once, she did not immediately check the next item.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我们去阅片室吧。阿尔托莉雅医生应该已经到了。」
lines.text_en: “Let’s go to the imaging room. Dr. Artoria should be there by now.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阅片室的光线比门诊暗了一些。大屏幕上，胰头附近的病灶轮廓被标注出来，旁边是一段彼此相连的蓝色静脉影像。」
lines.text_en: “The imaging room was slightly dimmer than the clinic. The lesion near the pancreatic head was marked on the screen, beside a connected stretch of venous anatomy shown in blue.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「舞弥，辛苦你过来了。我是阿尔托莉雅·潘德拉贡，今天和坂口医生一起向你说明手术计划。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya, thank you for coming. I’m Artoria Pendragon. Dr. Sakaguchi and I will explain the proposed operation together.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我听坂口医生说过。请开始吧。」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Sakaguchi told me. Please go ahead.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「影像显示胰头有一处约六厘米的肿物。结合检查，我们首先考虑实性假乳头状肿瘤，但最终性质仍需病理确认。」
lines.text_en: “The imaging shows a mass of roughly six centimeters in the pancreatic head. The findings favor a solid pseudopapillary neoplasm, though the final diagnosis will depend on pathology.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「目前不能完全确定，是吗？」
lines.text_en: “So it isn’t fully confirmed yet?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「对。我们不会把倾向性判断说成已经拿到的病理结果。」
lines.text_en: “Correct. We won’t present a working diagnosis as a final pathology result.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅走到屏幕旁，指尖停在病灶后侧的静脉走行附近。她没有立刻谈切口，而是先让舞弥看清两端正常的血管位置。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria moved beside the screen and pointed near the vein running behind the lesion. Rather than beginning with the incision, she first showed Maiya the normal vessel above and below it.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「真正让这台手术复杂的，不只是肿瘤大小。你看这里——病灶与门静脉、肠系膜上静脉相连的一段关系非常紧密。」
lines.text_en: “The size is not the only difficulty. Look here—the lesion is closely involved with a segment along the portal and superior mesenteric venous axis.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「如果把肿瘤从血管表面剥离出来，会不会简单一些？」
lines.text_en: “Would it be simpler to separate the tumor from the surface of the vein?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「这是我们首先评估过的可能。但目前的边界让我们无法有把握地做到安全、完整的分离。」
lines.text_en: “That was one of the first possibilities we assessed. But these planes do not give us enough confidence in a safe, complete separation.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「勉强沿着不清楚的界面剥离，可能使切除不完整，也可能损伤需要保留的血管壁。所以我们拟定的方案更大。」
lines.text_en: “Forcing the dissection along an uncertain plane could compromise completeness or damage the vessel wall we need to preserve. That is why our proposed operation is more extensive.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「胰头及相连的十二指肠等结构，需要按胰十二指肠切除术的原则处理。受累的静脉段也计划一并切除。」
lines.text_en: “We would remove the pancreatic head and associated structures according to the principles of pancreaticoduodenectomy, including the involved venous segment.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那段血管切掉以后呢？」
lines.text_en: “What happens after that segment of vein is removed?”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她的声音仍然平稳。只是原本放在膝上的双手收拢，指尖压住了资料夹的硬边。」
lines.text_en: “Her voice remained even. Only her hands changed, closing over the rigid edge of the folder on her lap.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我们会用预先准备好的静脉移植物，把两端重新连接起来。它不是手术结束时额外补做的一步，而是整台切除方案的一部分。」
lines.text_en: “We would use a prepared venous graft to reconnect the two ends. It isn’t an optional repair added at the finish; it’s part of the resection plan itself.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「也就是说，先切除，再把血流通道重新建立。」
lines.text_en: “So you remove the involved segment, then reconstruct the route for blood flow.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「准确地说，切除前就会建立好控制条件，移植物与重建路线也要先确认。真正的阻断时间里，我们不会浪费任何一步。」
lines.text_en: “More precisely, we establish vascular control and plan the graft route before resection. During the actual clamping interval, we cannot waste a step.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「血管恢复以后，还要完成胰肠、胆肠和胃肠重建。手术时间长，术后也需要严密监测。」
lines.text_en: “Once venous flow has been restored, we still have to reconstruct the pancreatic, biliary, and gastric connections. It is a long operation, followed by close monitoring.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「主要风险是什么？」
lines.text_en: “What are the main risks?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「术中出血、血管重建后的血流问题、吻合口相关并发症，以及术后的感染和恢复延迟。我们会逐项准备和监测，但不能向你保证零风险。」
lines.text_en: “Bleeding, problems with flow after vascular reconstruction, anastomotic complications, infection, and delayed recovery. We prepare and monitor for them, but we cannot promise zero risk.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥没有打断他。她听完以后，低头看了一眼自己的日历，却没有翻开。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya did not interrupt. When he finished, she glanced at her calendar but did not open it.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「如果我暂时不做手术，你们也会把这个选择和可能的后果讲清楚吧？」
lines.text_en: “If I decide not to have the operation yet, you would explain that option and its possible consequences too?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「会。你有权知道目前的判断、其他选择，以及推迟处理意味着什么。我们不会替你跳过这部分。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. You have a right to know our assessment, the alternatives, and what postponement may mean. We won’t skip that discussion.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「如果暂缓手术，我们会继续复查影像、观察症状。但病灶可能继续增大，与附近静脉的关系也可能变得更复杂。将来如果仍需切除，手术未必会比现在容易。」
lines.text_en: “If you postpone surgery, we would continue imaging follow-up and monitor your symptoms. But the mass could grow and involve the nearby veins more extensively. If resection is still needed later, the operation may be more complicated than it is now.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「至于刚才讨论的较小范围切除，也就是尝试把病灶从血管表面分离，目前无法有把握地保证安全、完整切除。因此我们不把它作为等价的替代方案。」
lines.text_en: “As for the more limited resection we discussed—trying to separate the mass from the vessel—we cannot be confident it would achieve a safe, complete removal in this case. We therefore do not consider it an equivalent alternative.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「但就现有资料而言，我们建议进行计划中的完整切除。不是因为这台手术值得挑战，而是因为我们认为这是对你更合适的治疗路线。」
lines.text_en: “With the information we have, we recommend the planned complete resection. Not because the operation is an impressive challenge, but because we believe it is the more appropriate treatment for you.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那就按你们建议的方案继续准备。」
lines.text_en: “Then let’s proceed with preparation for the operation you recommend.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我再确认一次：不是因为你不想麻烦别人，也不是因为我们把日程排好了。是你自己理解之后的决定？」
lines.text_en: “I want to confirm once more: not because you don’t want to inconvenience anyone, and not because we’ve already made a schedule. This is your own decision after understanding the plan?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「是。我想处理这个病灶。也知道手术不是一项能够完全按表执行的任务。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. I want the lesion treated. And I understand that surgery is not a task that can be executed entirely by schedule.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅取过手术说明书，把涉及静脉重建和术后监测的几页重新翻给她看。舞弥一页页读过去，遇到不明白的地方便停下来提问。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria handed her the surgical information sheets and turned again to the pages on venous reconstruction and postoperative monitoring. Maiya read through them, pausing whenever she needed clarification.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「最后一个问题。谁来主刀？」
lines.text_en: “One last question. Who will lead the operation?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text_en: “I will.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅医生呢？」
lines.text_en: “And Dr. Artoria?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我担任第一助手。最需要两人密切配合的阶段，我会一直在台边。」
lines.text_en: “I will be the first assistant. I’ll be at the table through the phases that demand the closest coordination.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥先看向坂口，又看向阿尔托莉雅。两人没有谁急着替对方补充一句保证。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya looked first at Sakaguchi, then at Artoria. Neither hurried to add a promise on the other’s behalf.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「明白了。请把最后的手术计划和需要我完成的术前事项交给我。」
lines.text_en: “Understood. Please give me the final plan and whatever I need to complete before surgery.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「术前事项会交给你。至于手术本身的工作，轮到我们完成了。」
lines.text_en: “We’ll give you the preparation checklist. The work of the operation itself is ours to do.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我已经看完，也问清楚了。请把同意书给我。」
lines.text_en: “I’ve read everything and asked my questions. Please give me the consent form.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口最后一次确认手术范围与同意内容，舞弥逐页核对后签下自己的名字。她把笔盖扣好，将文件交还给他。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi confirmed the scope of surgery and the consent details one last time. Maiya checked each page before signing her name, capped the pen, and handed the documents back.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「收到了。接下来我们会按计划完成术前准备，有任何新的疑问都可以直接问。」
lines.text_en: “Received. We’ll continue with the planned preparation. If any new questions come up, please ask.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「从阅片室回到办公室时，阿尔托莉雅没有立刻坐下。她先把桌上的两份图重新并排摆正：左边是切除前的静脉走行，右边是间置移植物完成后的预定路线。」
lines.text_en: “Back in the office, Artoria did not sit immediately. She straightened two diagrams side by side: the venous anatomy before resection, and the proposed route after graft reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「影像上最值得留意的不是肿瘤的圆形轮廓，而是这段被它压迫、牵扯的静脉。图上很短，到了术野里未必好处理。」
lines.text_en: “What matters most on these images is not the round outline of the tumor, but the vein it compresses and draws against itself. The segment looks short on a scan. In the field, it may not be straightforward.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我们预计缺损四到五厘米。强行拉近两端，不见得比间置移植物省事。」
lines.text_en: “We expect a defect of about four to five centimeters. Pulling the ends together would not necessarily be simpler than interposition.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「而且不能拿血管张力去换表面上的简洁。你看这里，脾静脉回流必须作为整张规划的一部分保留下来。」
lines.text_en: “And we cannot trade vascular tension for superficial simplicity. Look here: preserving splenic venous drainage must remain part of the entire plan.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「术前的解剖判断支持保留近端血管袖，但要在实际暴露后再次确认。」
lines.text_en: “The preoperative anatomy supports preserving the proximal venous cuff, but we need to confirm it after exposure.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「没错。若探查结果与图纸冲突，首先要重新评估，不能让手术为了迎合一张漂亮的示意图继续走下去。」
lines.text_en: “Exactly. If the field contradicts the drawing, we reassess first. We do not force the operation to conform to an attractive diagram.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口把另一份器械清单推过来。列表的后半部分密密麻麻，血管吻合之后还排着胰肠、胆肠和胃肠三处重建。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi slid over another instrument list. The second half was crowded: after the vascular anastomoses came the pancreatic, biliary, and gastric reconstructions.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这台手术真正难的，是把每一段都做得足够稳。完成重建血流以后，还要有精神处理后面三处吻合。」
lines.text_en: “The difficulty is keeping every phase steady. After restoring flow, we still need the concentration to complete three more anastomoses.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「所以我们不应把全部精力赌在某一个看起来最壮观的步骤上。」
lines.text_en: “Which is why we cannot spend all our concentration on the single step that looks most dramatic.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「听上去，你似乎已经准备好让我听一场很长的术前考试了。」
lines.text_en: “That sounds as if you have a very long preoperative examination prepared for me.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「如果你希望，我可以从第一张图考到最后一根缝线。」
lines.text_en: “If you wish, I can examine you from the first image all the way to the last suture.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「……我收回刚才的话。」
lines.text_en: “…I withdraw the suggestion.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅忍不住笑了一下，随即把重建计划翻到关键的一页。她的指尖落下，神情也重新认真起来。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria let out a brief laugh, then turned to the crucial page of the reconstruction plan. Her fingertip settled on the drawing, and her expression grew serious again.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「坂口君，这项手术的难度，你和我都清楚。我可以自己主刀，也有信心把它完成。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi, we both understand the difficulty of this operation. I could lead it myself, and I have confidence that I could complete it.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我知道。正因为如此，我才想确认：你真的决定坐第一助手的位置？」
lines.text_en: “I know. That’s exactly why I want to ask: have you truly decided to take the first assistant’s position?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「是。我不是为了证明自己能退后一步。手术台上的位置，本来就应该由这台手术需要什么来决定。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. Not to prove that I can step back. Positions at the table should be determined by what the operation needs.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「这次，我希望你完整地做一次主刀。从第一份计划到最后一次确认，所有关键判断都由你负责。」
lines.text_en: “This time, I want you to lead a complete case. From the first plan to the final verification, the key judgments will be yours.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「听起来不像一份轻松的礼物。」
lines.text_en: “That doesn’t sound like an easy gift.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「它也不是礼物。这是一台真实的手术。」
lines.text_en: “Nor is it a gift. It is a real operation.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她把写有第一助手职责的那页排程表翻给坂口看，自己的姓名端正地列在主刀下方。那里没有任何附注，也没有象征性的箭头。」
lines.text_en: “She turned the staffing sheet toward him. Her name sat neatly beneath his in the first assistant’s position. There was no special note, no symbolic arrow.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我会将需要知道的一切告诉你。至于下一步，你必须亲自判断。」
lines.text_en: “I will tell you everything you need to know. But your next move must be your own judgment.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「如果我想改动你最熟悉的操作顺序呢？」
lines.text_en: “What if I want to change a sequence you know better than anyone?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「只要理由充分，符合安全要求，我就会配合。若我看到危险，也会直接说出来。」
lines.text_en: “If your reasoning is sound and the safety conditions are met, I will support it. If I see a danger, I will say so directly.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「即使那会让你在所有人面前反驳我？」
lines.text_en: “Even if it means challenging me in front of the entire team?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「尤其在那种时候。真正好的第一助手，不该为了保护主刀的面子让患者承担风险。」
lines.text_en: “Especially then. A good first assistant must never put a patient at risk to protect a lead surgeon’s pride.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口点头。他知道她说的不是客套话；过去并肩工作时，阿尔托莉雅从来不会把准确的信息藏在温柔的语气后面。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi nodded. He knew it was no courtesy. In their earlier operations, Artoria had never hidden accurate information behind a gentle tone.”

choices.label: 「那就请你把最严格的标准也带上台。」
choices.label_en: “Then bring your strictest standards to the table.”

choices.label: 「这样一来，我可能会比平时更依赖你的意见。」
choices.label_en: “Then I may rely on your judgment even more than usual.”

choices.label: 「你真的放心把整台手术交给我？」
choices.label_en: “Are you truly comfortable entrusting the whole operation to me?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那就请你把最严格的标准也带上台。我不想要因为我们关系亲近而放宽的那一种。」
lines.text_en: “Then bring your strictest standards to the table. I don’t want a gentler version because we’re close.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「本来也没有那一种。你要小心，我很擅长记住别人说过的话。」
lines.text_en: “There was never such a version. Be careful—I am very good at remembering what people say.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这样一来，我可能会比平时更依赖你的意见。」
lines.text_en: “Then I may rely on your judgment even more than usual.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「依赖不是问题。只要别把自己的判断也交给我保管。」
lines.text_en: “Relying on me is not a problem. Just don’t hand over custody of your judgment as well.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你真的放心把整台手术交给我？」
lines.text_en: “Are you truly comfortable entrusting the whole operation to me?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「不。我会认真担心。那不妨碍我信任你。」
lines.text_en: “No. I will worry about it seriously. That does not prevent me from trusting you.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「好。术前影像、移植物、血管控制和重建的顺序，我们再一起过一遍。」
lines.text_en: “All right. Let’s go through the images, graft preparation, vascular control, and reconstruction sequence once more.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「正合我意。」
lines.text_en: “Just what I was hoping for.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「两人并肩坐下。桌面上的图纸被逐页翻开，一处接着一处的风险点被认真讨论，谁也没有因为熟悉彼此就省略问答。」
lines.text_en: “They sat side by side. Page after page of diagrams was opened, and one risk point after another was discussed. Familiarity with each other spared neither of them a single necessary question.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「等最后一页核对结束，天色已经渐暗。阿尔托莉雅在排程表的第一助手栏签下自己的名字，随后将笔递给坂口。」
lines.text_en: “By the time they finished the last page, the light outside had begun to fade. Artoria signed the first assistant’s line on the staffing sheet and handed the pen to Sakaguchi.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「明天我在你右手边。你可以放心要求我做任何第一助手应该完成的事。」
lines.text_en: “Tomorrow I’ll be at your right hand. Ask me for anything a first assistant should do.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那我会认真使用这份信任。」
lines.text_en: “Then I’ll take that trust seriously.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「病房窗外的天色暗了一些。舞弥已经换好病号服，坐在床沿，正把手里的一张便签重新折平。」
lines.text_en: “The daylight beyond the ward window had softened. Maiya, now in a hospital gown, sat on the edge of the bed smoothing a folded note.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「久宇小姐，明天的术前准备已经安排好了。今晚按医嘱休息，之后由我们再来核对。」
lines.text_en: “Ms. Hisau, tomorrow’s preoperative preparation is scheduled. Please rest tonight as instructed. We’ll return for the next checks.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我已经把可能需要的联系方式写好了。谢谢。」
lines.text_en: “I’ve written down the contact numbers you might need. Thank you.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「放在床头就行。今天不用再替我们值班了。」
lines.text_en: “You can leave them by the bed. You don’t have to take a shift for us today.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「护士带着记录夹离开。舞弥看着关上的门，像是认真考虑了一下『不用值班』这件事究竟该怎样执行。」
lines.text_en: “The nurse left with the chart. Maiya watched the door close, as if seriously considering how one was supposed to carry out the instruction ‘do not take a shift.’”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「适应得怎么样？」
lines.text_en: “How are you settling in?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这里的规定很明确。比我以为的容易遵守。」
lines.text_en: “The rules here are clear. Easier to follow than I expected.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「看起来你已经把病房的交接也整理好了。」
lines.text_en: “It appears you’ve already organized the ward handover too.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「只有一页。没有必要写更多。」
lines.text_en: “Only one page. There was no need for more.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「很大的进步。」
lines.text_en: “Considerable progress.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥看了他一眼，嘴角非常轻地动了一下。她把床头那份手术排程表拿过来，指向上面的一行。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya glanced at him, the faintest motion at the corner of her mouth. She picked up the operation schedule and pointed to one line.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「主刀是坂口医生，第一助手是阿尔托莉雅医生。我记住了。」
lines.text_en: “Lead surgeon: Dr. Sakaguchi. First assistant: Dr. Artoria. I’ve memorized it.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「你不需要背这份表。」
lines.text_en: “You don’t need to memorize the sheet.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这只是习惯。」
lines.text_en: “It’s a habit.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「还有一件事。静脉重建的移植物和需要的替代器械，都已经确认了吗？」
lines.text_en: “One more thing. Have the venous graft and the necessary backup instruments been confirmed?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「准备计划已经核查，明天入室前还会按手术流程再确认一次。手术中的技术判断，由我和阿尔托莉雅医生负责。」
lines.text_en: “The preparation plan has been checked, and we’ll verify it again before entering the operating room. Dr. Artoria and I will handle the technical decisions during surgery.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「明白。我不再替你们做第二份清单。」
lines.text_en: “Understood. I won’t make a second checklist for you.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我们会把每一项真正需要确认的事情都确认好。你今晚要做的，是让自己休息。」
lines.text_en: “We will verify everything that truly needs verification. Your task tonight is to rest.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这项任务的验收标准是什么？」
lines.text_en: “What are the acceptance criteria for that task?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「至少不要再把病床当办公室。」
lines.text_en: “For a start, don’t turn the hospital bed into an office.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥低头看向膝上的资料夹，沉默了两秒，然后把它收进床头抽屉。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya looked down at the folder on her lap. After two seconds of silence, she placed it in the bedside drawer.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这样呢？」
lines.text_en: “How about now?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「合格。」
lines.text_en: “Pass.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅忍着笑，替她把水杯移到更容易够到的位置。舞弥轻声道谢，没有再伸手拿出那份日程。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria suppressed a smile and moved Maiya’s water cup within easy reach. Maiya thanked her quietly and did not reach for her schedule again.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「明天……我会照你们说的做。」
lines.text_en: “Tomorrow… I’ll do as you ask.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「嗯。晚安，舞弥。」
lines.text_en: “All right. Good night, Maiya.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「明天见。」
lines.text_en: “See you tomorrow.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「房门合拢后，病房恢复了安静。舞弥伸手关上床头灯，黑暗里只剩下监护区远处很轻的脚步声。」
lines.text_en: “The room grew quiet after the door closed. Maiya switched off the bedside lamp. In the dark, only faint footsteps from the distant nursing area remained.”

day2.title: 这一次，交给你
day2.title_en: This Time, I Entrust It to You

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「第二天清晨，病房门口停着一张转运床。舞弥戴上手术帽，躺好后把双手平放在毯子边缘。」
lines.text_en: “Early the next morning, a transfer stretcher waited outside the ward room. Maiya put on a surgical cap, lay back, and rested both hands along the edge of the blanket.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「请再说一次你的姓名和今天接受的手术。」
lines.text_en: “Please tell me your name and the operation you’re having today.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「久宇舞弥。胰十二指肠切除，合并门肠静脉重建。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya Hisau. Pancreaticoduodenectomy with portomesenteric venous reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「核对正确。我们出发了。」
lines.text_en: “Confirmed. We’re moving now.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「转运床轻轻动起来。舞弥望着天花板的灯，一盏接着一盏从视线里滑过。」
lines.text_en: “The stretcher started moving. Maiya watched the ceiling lights pass above her, one after another.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我以前总是先确认路线。」
lines.text_en: “I usually check the route first.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「今天你只要躺稳，转弯我们会提前告诉你。」
lines.text_en: “Today, you only need to stay comfortable. We’ll warn you before each turn.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text_en: “…All right.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「在通往手术部的最后一个转角，舞弥的手指略微收紧。护士推床的动作始终平稳，没有催促，也没有让她自己去记下一条指令。」
lines.text_en: “At the final turn into the surgical area, Maiya’s fingers tightened slightly. The nurse kept the stretcher steady, neither rushing nor asking her to remember the next instruction.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「到接收区了。下一组同事会继续陪着你。」
lines.text_en: “We’re at the receiving area. The next team will stay with you.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「谢谢。」
lines.text_en: “Thank you.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「手术室的灯亮得很均匀。舞弥平躺在手术台上，手术帽边缘压住额前的碎发，护士正在为她接上监测装置。」
lines.text_en: “The operating-room lights were even and bright. Maiya lay flat on the table, the edge of her surgical cap holding back stray hair as the nurse attached monitoring devices.”

lines.speaker: anesthesiologist
lines.text: 「久宇小姐，我们再确认一次过敏史、禁食情况和今天的麻醉方案。之后会先给你吸氧，再由静脉给入全麻药物。」
lines.text_en: “Ms. Hisau, we’ll confirm your allergies, fasting status, and anesthetic plan once more. Then we’ll give you oxygen before administering the general anesthetic through your IV.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「明白。」
lines.text_en: “Understood.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她转动眼睛，看见坂口和阿尔托莉雅站在手术台另一侧。两人已经戴好帽子和口罩，熟悉的面孔只剩下眼睛可辨。」
lines.text_en: “She shifted her gaze and saw Sakaguchi and Artoria on the other side of the table. Caps and masks covered their faces, leaving only their eyes familiar.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「坂口医生。」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Sakaguchi.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我在。」
lines.text_en: “I’m here.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「如果我睡着以后，手术步骤和你们预计的不完全一样……」
lines.text_en: “If, after I’m asleep, the operation doesn’t follow your plan exactly…”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我们会按已经向你说明并取得同意的范围处理，遇到新的情况先评估安全与必要性。你不需要在麻醉前替我们预演所有变化。」
lines.text_en: “We’ll act within the scope we explained and you consented to, reassessing safety and necessity if circumstances change. You don’t have to rehearse every possibility for us before anesthesia.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥看了他一会儿，似乎还想再核对一句，最后却慢慢松开了原本抓住毯角的手。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya looked at him for a moment, as if another question were waiting. Instead, she gradually released her grip on the blanket.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……交给你们。」
lines.text_en: “…I’ll leave it to you.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我们接住了。接下来，好好睡一觉。」
lines.text_en: “We have it from here. Now, get some rest.”

lines.speaker: anesthesiologist
lines.text: 「我会一直在你头侧监测。现在开始给药。」
lines.text_en: “I’ll be here monitoring you the entire time. We’re starting the medication now.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「氧气面罩轻轻贴近。药物从静脉缓慢进入，舞弥的视线停在无影灯边缘，声音与光线一点点远去。」
lines.text_en: “The oxygen mask settled gently into place. As the medication entered through the IV, Maiya’s gaze rested at the edge of the surgical light. Sounds and light slowly receded.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她闭上了眼睛，再没有回应手术室里的谈话。」
lines.text_en: “She closed her eyes and gave no further response to the voices in the room.”

day3.title: 这一次，交给你
day3.title_en: This Time, I Entrust It to You

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「监护病房里，设备的声音规律而轻。舞弥已经醒来，半靠着枕背，望着床边记录板上刚更新的一行数字。」
lines.text_en: “The monitors in the recovery ward kept a quiet, regular rhythm. Maiya was awake, resting against a raised pillow as she studied a newly updated line of figures on the bedside chart.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「久宇小姐，醒来以后感觉怎么样？现在可以简短说话，想休息就告诉我。」
lines.text_en: “Ms. Hisau, how are you feeling now that you’re awake? You can speak briefly, but tell me if you need to rest.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「有点累。腹部不舒服，不过还能忍受。」
lines.text_en: “Tired. My abdomen is uncomfortable, but manageable.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「有疼痛或不适请直接说，我们会评估处理。你不需要靠忍耐来证明恢复得好。」
lines.text_en: “Please tell us about pain or discomfort so we can assess and treat it. You don’t have to prove you’re recovering well by enduring it.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……我记住了。」
lines.text_en: “…I’ll remember that.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「门被轻轻推开。坂口和阿尔托莉雅走到床边，先听护士交接监测记录，确认舞弥可以接受简短查房，才把注意力转向她。」
lines.text_en: “The door opened gently. Sakaguchi and Artoria approached, first receiving the nurse’s monitoring report and confirming Maiya was ready for a brief review before turning to her.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「舞弥，早上好。现在精神怎么样？」
lines.text_en: “Good morning, Maiya. How are you feeling?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「早上好。看来我真的睡过了一整台手术。」
lines.text_en: “Good morning. It seems I really did sleep through an entire operation.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「是的。你昨天非常认真地完成了最重要的一项工作。」
lines.text_en: “You did. And yesterday you carried out a very important task.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「保持昏睡？」
lines.text_en: “Remaining unconscious?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「让麻醉团队把你安全地带过那段时间。」
lines.text_en: “Allowing the anesthesia team to carry you safely through it.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥抬眼看着她，似乎认真分辨了一下这算不算夸奖。阿尔托莉雅的神情却十分坦然。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya looked up, apparently deciding whether that was a compliment. Artoria’s expression remained entirely sincere.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「手术……完成了吗？」
lines.text_en: “The operation… is finished?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「完成了。我们按计划切除了病灶及受累静脉段，建立了移植物通道，也完成了消化道重建。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. We removed the lesion and the involved venous segment as planned, established the graft connection, and completed the digestive reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「血管呢？」
lines.text_en: “And the vein?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「重建后已恢复血流，术中检查结果符合继续完成手术的条件。现在仍需要按术后计划严密观察。」
lines.text_en: “Flow was restored after reconstruction, and the intraoperative checks allowed us to proceed safely. We still need close postoperative surveillance.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「病理结果？」
lines.text_en: “Pathology?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「正式结果还没出来。我们不会在报告前替它下最后结论。」
lines.text_en: “The final report isn’t back yet. We won’t make the final call before it arrives.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥闭了闭眼，缓缓呼出一口气。她的指尖离开被单边缘，没有再去寻找床旁那块记录板。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya closed her eyes briefly and let out a slow breath. Her fingers relaxed from the edge of the blanket, and she did not look back toward the bedside chart.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那么，接下来我应该做什么？」
lines.text_en: “Then what should I do next?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「先恢复。疼痛、活动、进食和引流情况都需要由团队评估后逐步安排。」
lines.text_en: “Recover first. We’ll assess pain, mobility, eating, and drainage before advancing each part of the plan.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我可以自己记录吗？」
lines.text_en: “May I keep the records myself?”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「你当然可以问，也可以了解每一项。但记录板上已经有一整队人替你写。」
lines.text_en: “You can certainly ask questions and follow everything. But there’s already an entire team writing the chart for you.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……一整队人。」
lines.text_en: “…An entire team.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她安静了一会儿，随后把目光从记录板移开，落在站在床边的两名医生身上。」
lines.text_en: “She fell silent for a moment, then let her eyes leave the chart and settle on the two doctors beside her.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「昨天，阿尔托莉雅医生一直在台边？」
lines.text_en: “Dr. Artoria was at the table the entire time yesterday?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我一直在第一助手的位置。坂口医生带领了整台手术，团队的每一位同事也完成了自己的部分。」
lines.text_en: “I remained in the first assistant’s position. Dr. Sakaguchi led the operation, and every member of the team completed their part.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我想我明白了。」
lines.text_en: “I think I understand.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「舞弥看向坂口，轻轻点头。那动作仍旧克制，却比术前任何一张签署完毕的表格都更像是她自己的回答。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya turned to Sakaguchi and nodded lightly. The gesture was restrained, yet it felt more like her own answer than any completed form from before the operation.”

choices.label: 「你已经做得很好。现在可以让我们接手。」
choices.label_en: “You’ve done your part well. You can let us take over now.”

choices.label: 「要不要听听我们接下来的恢复计划？」
choices.label_en: “Would you like to hear the next steps in your recovery plan?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你已经做得很好。现在可以让我们接手，不必比我们更早知道每一项结果。」
lines.text_en: “You’ve done your part well. You can let us take over. You don’t have to learn every result before we do.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这恐怕要花一点时间适应。不过……我会试试。」
lines.text_en: “That may take some getting used to. But… I’ll try.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「要不要听听我们接下来的恢复计划？你可以知道所有重要环节，不必自己执行每一项。」
lines.text_en: “Would you like to hear the recovery plan? You can understand every important step without carrying out all of them yourself.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「请说。知道有人负责，和必须自己负责，是两回事。」
lines.text_en: “Please. Knowing someone is responsible is different from having to be responsible myself.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「舞弥，先把眼睛闭一会儿吧。这里有人替你看着记录。」
lines.text_en: “Maiya, close your eyes for a little while. Someone here is watching the chart for you.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……这一次，我相信。」
lines.text_en: “…This time, I believe you.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她的手慢慢松开，平放在被单上。阿尔托莉雅替她把被角整理好。舞弥没有再抬头核对墙上的钟，任由病房安静下来。」
lines.text_en: “Her hand relaxed against the blanket. Artoria straightened its edge. Maiya did not look up to check the wall clock again, allowing the room to grow quiet.”

lines.speaker: ward_nurse
lines.text: 「下一项监测时间到了。两位医生，剩下的交给我吧。」
lines.text_en: “It’s time for the next monitoring check. Doctors, I’ll take it from here.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「辛苦了。」
lines.text_en: “Thank you.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「两名医生离开前，舞弥睁开眼睛，朝他们轻轻点了一下头。随后她重新闭眼，病房护士在床边继续记录。」
lines.text_en: “Before the doctors left, Maiya opened her eyes and gave them a small nod. Then she closed them again as the nurse resumed the bedside charting.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「复盘室里只有两个人。阿尔托莉雅把厚厚的手术记录放在桌上，第一页已经被她用细小的书签标出几处关键阶段。」
lines.text_en: “There were only two people in the review room. Artoria laid the thick operative record on the table, with small tabs marking several important phases.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我以为你会先让我回去睡一觉。」
lines.text_en: “I thought you were going to send me home to sleep first.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我本来是这么打算的。可是你刚才看着病房记录，已经在心里复盘第三遍了吧？」
lines.text_en: “That was my plan. But you were already reviewing the case for the third time while looking at her chart, weren’t you?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「……有那么明显？」
lines.text_en: “…Was it that obvious?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「非常明显。」
lines.text_en: “Very.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她打开记录，没有先谈手术总时长，也没有先看结算评价。笔尖落在血管切除与移植物重建之间那一段。」
lines.text_en: “She opened the record without beginning with the total duration or the final evaluation. Her pen settled on the interval between venous resection and graft reconstruction.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「这里。我想先听你的判断。为什么当时一定要在继续下一步前，再确认一次静脉轴向？」
lines.text_en: “Here. I want to hear your reasoning first. Why did you insist on checking the venous axis again before proceeding?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「因为一旦复灌，位置就不再只是纸上和视野里的问题。通畅、张力和走行都需要在那个节点重新核对。」
lines.text_en: “Because after reperfusion, the position is no longer just a matter of the plan and the view. Patency, tension, and course all have to be checked at that point.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「正是这样。你先确认了能否安全继续，而不是被『终于快恢复血流了』的感觉催着向前。」
lines.text_en: “Exactly. You checked whether it was safe to proceed instead of being hurried along by the feeling that flow was almost restored.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「但那段还是很紧张。时间越久，我越能感觉到每个人在等这个确认。」
lines.text_en: “It was still tense. The longer it took, the more I could feel everyone waiting for that confirmation.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「那不是坏事。压力不会因为你不看它就消失。关键是你有没有让它代替判断。」
lines.text_en: “That isn’t a bad thing. Pressure does not disappear because you refuse to look at it. What matters is whether you let it make the decision for you.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口低头看着那页记录。后面还有胰肠、胆肠、胃肠三处吻合，以及漫长的最终核对。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi looked down at the record. Beyond that point lay three digestive anastomoses and a long final verification.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「血管复灌以后，我有一瞬间确实想松口气。可后面还有那么多工作。」
lines.text_en: “After reperfusion, I did want to relax for a moment. But there was still so much work ahead.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「所以这台手术才不能只用『血管接好了』来概括。每一个阶段都要完整；你和我都知道，手术不会因为最醒目的难点过去就自动结束。」
lines.text_en: “That is why ‘we reconnected the vein’ cannot summarize this operation. Every phase must be complete. We both know a case does not end merely because its most conspicuous difficulty is behind us.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「第一次完整主刀这种规模的重建，我更清楚为什么你要求每一步都要能被团队验证。」
lines.text_en: “Leading a reconstruction of this scale from start to finish made me understand even more clearly why you insist that every step must be verifiable by the team.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「那是为了患者。也是为了我们自己。一个人再有经验，也不该让整台手术只存在于自己的脑子里。」
lines.text_en: “It is for the patient. And for us. However experienced someone may be, an entire operation should never exist only inside one person’s head.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你今天还会说『我来做会更快』吗？」
lines.text_en: “Would you still say, ‘It would be faster if I did it myself’?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「在某些步骤上？也许会。」
lines.text_en: “For certain steps? Perhaps.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她回答得很坦然，反倒让坂口抬头笑了。」
lines.text_en: “She answered without hesitation, making Sakaguchi look up with a smile.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我们都还有比对方做得更熟练的事。那不是什么需要回避的事实。可今天，我在第一助手的位置上看得很清楚——你知道什么时候该继续，什么时候需要停下来听别人说话。」
lines.text_en: “Each of us still has things we do more fluently than the other. There is no reason to deny that. But from the first assistant’s position today, I could see clearly that you knew when to proceed and when to stop and listen.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你在台边补充的意见，救了我很多次思考的时间。」
lines.text_en: “Your observations at the table saved me a great deal of time thinking through the next move.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「那就是第一助手应该做的事。」
lines.text_en: “That is what a first assistant should do.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你把这样一台手术交给我，不会觉得少了什么吗？」
lines.text_en: “Entrusting an operation like this to me—doesn’t it feel as if you’ve given something up?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「少了什么？」
lines.text_en: “Given up what?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「比如说，原本完全属于你的技术。」
lines.text_en: “Something that used to be entirely your technique.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅没有立即回答。她把那份手术记录合上，指尖在封面上轻轻停了一下。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria did not answer immediately. She closed the operative record and rested her fingertips on its cover for a moment.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「技术从来不会因为别人学会了，就从原来的人身上消失。」
lines.text_en: “A skill never disappears from its original owner because someone else has learned it.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我依然能做这台手术。你现在也能把完整的责任接起来。对星见医院而言，这是多了一双可靠的手，而不是少了一位主刀。」
lines.text_en: “I can still perform this operation. Now you can carry its full responsibility too. For Hoshimi, that means one more dependable pair of hands—not one fewer surgeon.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「听上去，你对这次的结果还算满意。」
lines.text_en: “That sounds as if you’re fairly satisfied with how this went.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「我对舞弥现在的恢复情况感到欣慰。至于这份记录，我们以后还有许多地方值得继续讨论。」
lines.text_en: “I am relieved by Maiya’s current recovery. As for this record, there will be plenty for us to keep discussing.”

choices.label: 「你还真是不肯给我一个轻松的结业评语。」
choices.label_en: “You really won’t give me an easy graduation verdict.”

choices.label: 「以后轮到你主刀，我也会这样认真做第一助手。」
choices.label_en: “When you lead the next case, I’ll be just as thorough as your first assistant.”

choices.label: 「最值得记下来的，是今天所有人都在各自的位置上。」
choices.label_en: “What’s most worth remembering is that everyone held their own position today.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你还真是不肯给我一个轻松的结业评语。」
lines.text_en: “You really won’t give me an easy graduation verdict.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「你从来不是我的学生。这台也不是毕业考试。若你想要表扬，我可以另外写一份。」
lines.text_en: “You were never my student, and this was never a graduation examination. If you want praise, I can write you a separate note.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那还是留着写病历吧。」
lines.text_en: “Better save the paper for the medical record.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「以后轮到你主刀，我也会这样认真做第一助手。」
lines.text_en: “When you lead the next case, I’ll be just as thorough as your first assistant.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「当然。我若在台上有看漏的地方，也需要你直接指出来。」
lines.text_en: “Of course. If I overlook something while leading, I need you to say so directly.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「一言为定。」
lines.text_en: “Agreed.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「最值得记下来的，是今天所有人都在各自的位置上。」
lines.text_en: “What’s most worth remembering is that everyone held their own position today.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「嗯。有人切开，有人牵开，有人监测，有人检查。今天每个岗位都没有缺席。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. Someone dissected, someone provided exposure, someone monitored, someone checked. Every role was present today.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「也包括愿意把主刀位交出来的那个人。」
lines.text_en: “Including the person willing to let someone else lead.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「也包括真正接下那个位置的人。」
lines.text_en: “And the person who truly accepted that position.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅把记录重新打开，把两人下一次需要复核的问题写在纸页边缘。没有奖章，没有夸张的仪式，只有几个具体得不能再具体的临床问题。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria reopened the record and noted the questions they still needed to review. No medal, no elaborate ceremony—only a handful of very concrete clinical questions.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「走吧。再待下去，今晚我们恐怕又会讨论到半夜。」
lines.text_en: “Come on. If we stay, we’ll be discussing this until midnight again.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「你刚才明明已经准备好下一轮考试了。」
lines.text_en: “You had the next examination prepared already.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「是复盘，不是考试。」
lines.text_en: “It’s a review, not an examination.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我先把这句话记下来。」
lines.text_en: “I’ll make a note of that.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「离开复盘室后，阿尔托莉雅在走廊饮水机旁停下，接了两杯水。坂口伸手接过其中一杯时，瞥见墙边刚更新的手术排班板。」
lines.text_en: “After leaving the review room, Artoria stopped at the corridor water dispenser and filled two cups. As Sakaguchi accepted one, he noticed the newly updated surgery roster on the wall.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「下周还有好几台大手术。你今天说的话，要不要当成以后把复杂病例都交给我的正式通知？」
lines.text_en: “There are several major operations next week. Should I take what you said today as official notice that all the difficult cases will be handed to me from now on?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「当然不行。我还没有打算放弃自己喜欢的手术。」
lines.text_en: “Of course not. I have no intention of giving up the operations I love.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那我放心了。」
lines.text_en: “That’s a relief.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「不过，如果下次你主刀的病例需要我，而排班又允许……给我留个第一助手的位置。」
lines.text_en: “But if your next case needs me, and the roster allows it… save me a place as first assistant.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我会认真考虑。不过我们也有很多优秀的同事，不一定每次都轮到你。」
lines.text_en: “I’ll consider it carefully. Though we have many excellent colleagues, so it won’t necessarily be your turn every time.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「这才是正确的答案。」
lines.text_en: “That is the right answer.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「她把水杯举到唇边，像终于结束了一场普通的术后会议。走廊另一端，有护士推着空转运床经过，车轮的声音很快远去。」
lines.text_en: “She raised the paper cup to her lips, as though an ordinary postoperative meeting had finally concluded. Far down the corridor, a nurse pushed an empty transfer stretcher past, its wheels fading into the distance.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「舞弥的事情，之后还需要我们一起盯着。」
lines.text_en: “We’ll still need to follow Maiya’s recovery together.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「嗯。她正在学着把记录交给别人，我们却不能因此忘了继续做好记录。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. She’s learning to leave the chart in other people’s hands. That is all the more reason for us to keep it properly.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「放心。我已经准备好下一份交接表了。」
lines.text_en: “Don’t worry. I’ve already prepared the next handover sheet.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「坂口君。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text_en: “Yes?”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「今天的交接，你做得很好。」
lines.text_en: “You handled today’s handover well.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「坂口低头看了看手里的纸杯，还没来得及回答，阿尔托莉雅已经朝医局走去。她没有回头催促，只在门口略微放慢脚步，等他跟上来。」
lines.text_en: “Sakaguchi glanced down at his paper cup. Before he could answer, Artoria was already walking toward the medical office. She did not turn to hurry him, but slowed a little at the doorway until he caught up.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「阿尔托莉雅，等等。我还真有一份下周的排班要和你确认。」
lines.text_en: “Artoria, wait. I actually do have next week’s roster to go over with you.”

lines.speaker: doc_artoria
lines.text: 「那就走吧。我们还有工作。」
lines.text_en: “Then let’s go. We still have work to do.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 「两个人并肩走进明亮的医局。新一天的手术排程正等着他们，而这一次，桌上多了一份由坂口主刀完成的复杂重建记录。」
lines.text_en: “They entered the brightly lit office side by side. The next day’s surgical schedule was waiting, and among the records on the desk was a complex reconstruction now completed under Sakaguchi’s lead.”
